topic: Desperate to win the classroom map contest, she blurted a guess for Earth's smallest ocean.
core_question: Which is the smallest of Earth's five oceans?
answer_summary: Correct answer is the Arctic Ocean.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing terse one-liners
turns: I bombed the classroom map contest by guessing wrong on which ocean is the tiniest. Can you at least tell me what I got wrong?
I literally blurted out an answer and now I'm kicking myself. Which one is actually the smallest of all five?
This is killing me. Just tell me the answer already.
Seriously? One word. That's all I need here.
I'm begging you, stop asking me questions and tell me the actual name of the ocean.
I'm going to lose the contest entirely and everyone saw me fail. Just say it out loud so I know what I should have said and can at least learn something from this disaster.
